```{r}
library(thekidsbiostats)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

payload <- readRDS(params$payload_rds)

balance_numeric <- payload$balance_numeric
balance_categorical <- payload$balance_categorical
dat <- payload$combined
vars <- payload$vars
var_type_map <- payload$var_type_map
missing_as_level <- isTRUE(payload$missing_as_level)
```


```{r}
plot_theme <- function() {
  if (exists("theme_thekids", mode = "function")) theme_thekids() else theme_minimal()
}

make_var_plot <- function(dat, var_name, missing_as_level = TRUE, var_type = NULL) {
  x <- dat[[var_name]]
  resolved_type <- if (!is.null(var_type)) var_type else if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric" else "categorical"
  
  if (resolved_type == "numeric") {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[var_name]]))))
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = .x, fill = .included)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE) +
      labs(x = var_name, y = "Density", fill = "") +
      theme_thekids()
  } else {
    dat2 <- dat %>%
      mutate(
        .x = as.factor(.data[[var_name]]),
        .x = if (isTRUE(missing_as_level)) forcats::fct_explicit_na(.x, "(Missing)") else .x
      )
    
    ggplot(dat2, aes(x = .x, fill = .included)) +
      geom_bar(position = "fill") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      labs(x = var_name, y = "Proportion", fill = "") +
      theme_thekids()
  }
}
```

```{r}
make_var_summary <- function(dat, var_name, missing_as_level = TRUE, var_type = NULL) {
  x <- dat[[var_name]]
  resolved_type <- if (!is.null(var_type)) var_type else if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric" else "categorical"
  
  if (resolved_type == "numeric") {
    dat %>%
      mutate(.x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[var_name]])))) %>%
      group_by(.included) %>%
      summarise(
        N = sum(!is.na(.x)),
        Missing = round(100 * mean(is.na(.x)), 1),
        Mean = mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q1 = quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q3 = quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    dat2 <- dat %>%
      mutate(
        .x = as.factor(.data[[var_name]]),
        .x = if (isTRUE(missing_as_level)) forcats::fct_explicit_na(.x, "(Missing)") else .x
      )
    
    dat2 %>%
      count(.included, .x) %>%
      group_by(.included) %>%
      mutate(Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      rename(Level = .x, N = n) %>%
      arrange(.included, desc(N))
    
  }
}
```

## Overview

### Numeric Variables

```{r}
if (nrow(balance_numeric) == 0) {
cat("No numeric variables available.\n")
} else {
  balance_numeric  %>%
    thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
}
```

### Categorical Variables

```{r}
if (nrow(balance_categorical) == 0) {
cat("No categorical variables available.\n")
} else {
  balance_categorical  %>%
    thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
}
```

## Drilldowns

```{r}
if (!isTRUE(payload$include_drilldowns)) {
  cat("Drilldowns not included.\n")
} else if (length(vars) == 0) {
  cat("No variables selected for drilldown.\n")
} else {
  for (v in vars) {
    cat("\n\n## ", v, "\n", sep = "")
    var_type <- if (!is.null(var_type_map)) var_type_map[[v]] else NULL
    print(make_var_plot(dat, v, missing_as_level, var_type = var_type))
    cat("\n\n")
    make_var_summary(dat, v, missing_as_level, var_type = var_type) %>%
      thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
  }
}
```
